summary: Added an additive targeted_repair_plan surface to analyze_payload. It creates paragraph-scoped repair units only for failed or unverified paragraphs, combining pN issue targets, structured writing plan missing markers, and approved-facts audit unapproved markers. It does not rewrite the draft, call a model, query the library database, or change existing analysis semantics.
implemented: backend/server.py: added _paragraph_index_from_target(target) for stable pN issue mapping.
backend/server.py: added build_targeted_repair_plan(payload, analysis), returning method=targeted_repair_plan_v1, can_repair, repair_units, and summary.
Repair units are created only for paragraph-indexed failures, structured_writing_plan needs_verification paragraphs, or approved_facts_audit uses_unapproved_facts paragraphs.

Each repair unit includes paragraph_index, original_text, issue_codes, source_targets, required_markers, missing_markers, unapproved_markers, allowed_fact_ids, instruction, locked=false, and scope=paragraph_only.
Instruction strings explicitly require rewriting only that paragraph, preserving unrelated paragraphs, and using only approved facts/evidence listed in allowed_fact_ids.
No draft text is modified and no full-document rewrite is generated.
tools/run_quality_gates.py py-compile gate now includes tests/test_targeted_repair_plan.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary.
